findings.title: ERC-7201 storage location hashes unverified
findings.impact: Protocol bricked on upgrade — all state lost

evidence.note: ENGINE_STORAGE_LOCATION constant
STAKE_VAULT_STORAGE_LOCATION constant

exploit_sketch: All state reads return zero — protocol bricked
findings.recommended_fix: Add Foundry test verifying constants match keccak256 derivation formula. Fix if incorrect.

findings.title: Vault share transfers bypass all lock mechanisms
findings.impact: All economic security negated; slashing permanently bricked

evidence.note: Missing _update override — shares freely transferable
_burnShares reverts if user transferred shares away

exploit_sketch: User locks stake (contributor lock, validator capacity, or in-flight)
User transfers vault shares to fresh address via ERC20.transfer()
Fresh address has zero locks — can redeem full balance
Original address has locks but no shares — slashing reverts
All consensus settlements, dispute resolutions, and claim expiries that touch this user are permanently bricked
findings.recommended_fix: Override _update() to prevent transfers that leave sender shares below their locked amount.

findings.title: bytes32(0) commit hash bypasses duplicate-commit check — DoS vector
findings.impact: Permanent contribution DoS at zero cost

evidence.note: Guard: commitHashes != bytes32(0) — bypassed when commitHash IS bytes32(0)

exploit_sketch: Attacker calls commitValidation with commitHash=bytes32(0) and stakeAmount=0
Guard doesn't trigger (bytes32(0) != bytes32(0) is false)
Repeat N times to fill all numberOfValidations slots
bytes32(0) can never match a valid reveal hash
Contribution permanently stuck — cancelExpiredCommitment doesn't fix it (H-01)

findings.title: Missing validationClaimCount decrement in cancelExpiredCommitment
findings.impact: Contributions permanently stuck after validator timeout

evidence.note: Clears commit data but does not decrement validationClaimCount

findings.title: Escrow insolvency — validator rewards are additive, not carved from contributor share
findings.impact: Protocol cannot pay all rewards; last claimants get nothing

evidence.note: settleValidator: reward from totalRewards pool
releaseContributorReward: also from totalRewards pool
With validatorRewardBps=2500: total obligations = 125% of escrow

findings.recommended_fix: Either carve validator rewards from contributor share (contributor gets rewardRate*(BPS-validatorBps)/BPS) or increase escrow funding requirement.

findings.title: consensusSettled not keyed by nonce — validators cannot re-settle after rejection
findings.impact: Validators locked out of re-validations on same index

evidence.note: consensusSettled keyed by (projectId, index, validator) without nonce
settleValidator checks settled and sets it permanently

findings.recommended_fix: Key consensusSettled by (projectId, index, nonce, validator).

findings.title: No unlock path for validator capacity
findings.impact: Validator stake permanently trapped — cannot withdraw or reduce commitment

evidence.note: setValidatorCapacity only locks, never unlocks
unlockValidatorCapacity exists but requires ENGINE_ROLE — never called by Engine

findings.recommended_fix: Add reduceValidatorCapacity(uint256 amount) function that calls vault.unlockValidatorCapacity.

findings.title: Zero-stake validators — free option attack
findings.impact: Risk-free consensus manipulation; undermines economic security model

evidence.note: stakeAmount=0 is allowed
Zero-stake gets weight=1, can still earn rewards with zero slash risk

findings.recommended_fix: Enforce minimum stake per validation. Add minValidationStake to Project config or as a global parameter.

findings.title: Validator adapter fee not deducted from projectEscrow
findings.impact: Phantom escrow balance — insolvency when feature is enabled

evidence.note: Fee credited to adapter pendingRewards but escrow only decremented by post-fee amount

findings.recommended_fix: Deduct full pre-fee reward from escrow: $.projectEscrow -= originalReward.

findings.title: Fee-on-transfer tokens break fundProject accounting
findings.impact: Escrow overstated — last claimants cannot withdraw

evidence.note: Credits escrow based on amount, not actual received

findings.title: No project completion or escrow refund mechanism
findings.impact: Remaining escrow and originator stake permanently locked

evidence.note: ProjectStatus.Completed defined but never set

findings.title: Dispute resolution escrow underflow — no guard on challenger reward deduction
findings.impact: Disputes permanently stuck in Open status

evidence.note: Deducts from escrow without >= check (upheld acceptance)
Same pattern in escalateDispute

findings.recommended_fix: Add underflow guard: if (challengerReward > 0 && escrow >= challengerReward).

findings.title: No timelock on admin upgrades or parameter changes
findings.impact: Instant rug via admin key compromise

evidence.note: _authorizeUpgrade with no timelock
Same pattern

findings.recommended_fix: Deploy behind TimelockController. 48h minimum on upgrades, 24h on parameter changes.

evidence.note: Declared in storage
